claim: Patchline ships adoption case studies showing teams using it alongside their existing CI, observability, and migration tooling, with each narrative anchored to the specific gate-backed capabilities the team relied on rather than to marketing claims. Every case study declares the integration context, the capabilities used, and a measurable outcome, and the worker renders a narrative plus an integration matrix. The gate proves that the CI, observability, and migration integration contexts are all represented and that every capability cited by a case study maps to a real gate.
real_repo: patchline (self): case-study capabilities validated against scripts/*-gate.sh

case_studies.outcome: Blocked a destructive Cassandra DROP in a pull request before merge.
Correlated an SLO breach to a high-severity migration finding within minutes.
Caught an unordered migration Job that would have raced its deploy.
